info.name: Campus Printing and Document Submission Management System Midterm - part-a
info.description: Isange Nelly - 27818. A1–A2: five entities, enum and CRUD. The Docker database starts with a backup of data entered through Part A endpoints. Run folders in order. F2 changes the October 20 seed statuses.
